sources.quote: a change of coating or surface treatment.
Aurelia Automobili - Supplier Quality Manual, revision 4, section 7 "Changes". Replaces revision 3.
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: BK-330 belongs to PRG-Z (Aurelia). The claim that a coating change needs only notification comes from revision 3, which revision 4 replaces. Under revision 4, changing the coating from zinc-nickel to zinc flake needs written Aurelia approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipment, plus notification at least 90 days ahead. No approval or deviation in the documents covers this change.
